claims: Early 2026 Oscar predictions for Best Supporting Actress heavily favor Teyana Taylor (One Battle After Another) and Amy Madigan (Weapons) as the frontrunners.

Other top contenders for the 98th Academy Awards, based on industry, critical, and award chatter, include Ariana Grande (Wicked: For Good), Wunmi Mosaku (Sinners), and Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas or Elle Fanning (Sentimental Value).
